list_agents.title: List agents
list_agents.description: List every AI voice agent on the account with its system prompt, greeting, voice, transfer number and assigned phone number. Use it to find the agent id the calling and messaging tools need.

create_agent.title: Create an agent
create_agent.description: Create an AI voice agent with a system prompt, opening greeting, voice, human transfer number and voicemail message. It cannot call anyone until buy_phone_number gives it a number. Calls from owner_phone put the agent in task mode, where it takes instructions rather than serving the caller.

name.description: Display name for the AI voice agent

system_prompt.description: Default instructions for the agent's personality and behavior on ALL calls (inbound and outbound). Can be overridden per-call via POST /v1/calls.

initial_greeting.description: Default opening line spoken on ALL calls (inbound and outbound), e.g. 'Hello, how can I help you today?'. Can be overridden per-call via POST /v1/calls.

voice_id.description: TTS voice preset name (e.g. 'female-1', 'male-1') or Cartesia voice UUID; defaults to system voice if not set

transfer_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format to transfer calls to (e.g. a human operator fallback)

voicemail_message.description: Message the AI agent leaves if the call goes to voicemail

owner_phone.description: Owner's phone number in E.164 format (e.g. '+12125551234'). Calls from this number enter task mode — the agent treats speech as executable instructions.

output.description: The created agent, with its id.

get_agent.title: Get an agent
get_agent.description: Read one AI voice agent's full configuration -- system prompt, greeting, voice, transfer number, voicemail message and owner phone.

update_agent.title: Update an agent
update_agent.description: Change any of an agent's settings. Only the fields sent change; the new values apply from the next call, never to one already in progress.

name.description: New display name for the AI voice agent

system_prompt.description: Updated default instructions for ALL future calls (does not affect calls already in progress)

initial_greeting.description: Updated default greeting for ALL future calls (inbound and outbound)

voice_id.description: New TTS voice preset name or Cartesia voice UUID

transfer_number.description: Updated transfer phone number in E.164 format

owner_phone.description: Updated owner phone number in E.164 format for task mode

delete_agent.title: Delete an agent
delete_agent.description: Permanently delete an agent along with its calls, messages and conversations. Its phone number stays on the account, detached, and can be reassigned.

list_phone_numbers.title: List phone numbers
list_phone_numbers.description: List every phone number bought on the account, with the agent it is assigned to, its country and whether it is active or released.

buy_phone_number.title: Buy a phone number
buy_phone_number.description: Buy a real US phone number and attach it to an agent, optionally local or toll-free and in a preferred area code. This charges the account balance, and an agent that already has an active number is refused.

country.description: Country of the number; only US is supported.

area_code.description: Preferred three-digit US area code, e.g. 415.

pattern.description: Legacy digit pattern to match; prefer area_code.

output.description: The purchased number and its assignment.

get_phone_number.title: Get a phone number
get_phone_number.description: Read one phone number -- the E.164 number, its assigned agent, provider id, country and status.

attach_existing_number.title: Attach an existing number
attach_existing_number.description: Attach a number bought directly in the SignalWire dashboard to an agent, rather than buying one through AgentLine. The agent must not already have an active number.

phone_number.description: The number in E.164 format, e.g. +12125551234.

agent_id.description: Agent to attach the number to.

reassign_number.title: Reassign a number
reassign_number.description: Move a phone number to a different agent. The number stays active; only ownership changes, and the target agent must not already hold an active number.

agent_id.description: Agent to move the number to.

make_outbound_call.title: Place an outbound call
make_outbound_call.description: Have an agent phone someone. The call is real and the agent conducts it on its own, using its configured prompt, greeting and voice unless overridden for this call. It is billed per minute; the transcript is saved and arrives as a call.completed event.

to_number.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. '+12125551234')

system_prompt.description: Per-call system prompt override. Replaces the agent's default prompt for this call ONLY. If omitted, the agent's default system_prompt is used.

initial_greeting.description: Per-call greeting override. Replaces the agent's default greeting for this call ONLY. If omitted, the agent's default initial_greeting is used.

voice_id.description: Override the TTS voice for this call: preset name (e.g. 'female-1') or Cartesia UUID

from_number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to call from; defaults to the agent's assigned number

output.description: The initiated call, with its id and status.

list_calls.title: List calls
list_calls.description: List inbound and outbound calls, newest first, optionally for one agent or in one status (initiated, in-progress, completed or failed), with direction, numbers and duration.

agent_id.description: Only calls handled by this agent.

status.description: Only calls in this status: initiated, in-progress, completed or failed.

get_call.title: Get a call
get_call.description: Read one call -- direction, numbers, status, duration, the agent configuration it ran with and its full transcript.

get_call_transcript.title: Get a call transcript
get_call_transcript.description: Read just the transcript of a call, turn by turn, each labelled human (the other party) or assistant (the agent).

hangup_call.title: Hang up a call
hangup_call.description: End a call that is in progress. The final transcript and billing are processed after it ends.

output.description: Confirmation that the call was ended.

push_call_context.title: Speak a reply on a live call
push_call_context.description: Answer a caller on a live relay-mode call. After a call.utterance event, send the short caller-ready reply here with that event's turn_id; the agent speaks it verbatim. A 409 means the turn went stale, a 410 that the call has ended -- stop working on it.

context.description: Exactly what the caller should hear -- keep it short and conversational.

turn_id.description: The turn_id from the call.utterance event being answered.

output.description: delivered and status (live, or duplicate for a retried identical reply).

send_sms.title: Send an SMS
send_sms.description: Send a text message, or an MMS with a media URL, from an agent's phone number. It is delivered for real and cannot be recalled.

to_number.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format (e.g. '+12125551234')

from_number_id.description: Specific phone number ID to send from; defaults to the agent's assigned number

output.description: The sent message with its delivery status.

list_messages.title: List messages
list_messages.description: List SMS messages sent and received, optionally for one agent or one conversation thread, with direction, numbers, body and delivery status.

conversation_id.description: Only messages in this conversation thread.

list_conversations.title: List SMS conversations
list_conversations.description: List SMS threads -- one per external contact an agent's number has exchanged messages with -- optionally for one agent. Pass a thread's id to list_messages to read it.

poll_events.title: Poll events
poll_events.description: Take pending events from the mailbox -- call.completed, call.failed, call.utterance, sms.received and so on. Reading consumes them: an event returned here will not be returned again, so process everything you receive. Use peek_events to look without consuming.

event_type.description: Only events of this type, e.g. call.completed.

output.description: The events, now removed from the mailbox.

peek_events.title: Peek at events
peek_events.description: Preview pending mailbox events without consuming them, to check whether there is anything to process before calling poll_events.

output.description: The pending events, left in the mailbox.

list_webhooks.title: List webhooks
list_webhooks.description: Read the webhook configured for each agent, or for one agent. Secrets come back masked; the full secret is only shown when a webhook is set.

set_webhook.title: Set an agent's webhook
set_webhook.description: Create or replace the webhook that receives all of an agent's events as HMAC-SHA256 signed JSON POSTs. Each agent has at most one; setting it again replaces it. Keep the returned secret -- it is not shown again.

url.description: HTTPS URL that will receive this agent's events as signed JSON POSTs. Setting this replaces any existing webhook for the agent.

secret.description: Optional HMAC signing secret. Auto-generated if omitted. Used to verify the signature header on delivered payloads.

signature_header.description: Header name for the HMAC-SHA256 signature of the raw body. Defaults to 'X-Webhook-Signature' (natively verified by Hermes, OpenClaw, and other agent platforms). Set to 'X-Hub-Signature-256' for GitHub-style verification, or any custom header name your platform expects. Omit to keep the existing value when updating.

output.description: The webhook, including its signing secret this one time.

delete_webhook.title: Delete an agent's webhook
delete_webhook.description: Remove an agent's webhook. Its events keep accumulating in the mailbox for poll_events instead.

test_webhook.title: Send a test webhook
test_webhook.description: Fire a signed webhook.test event at an agent's webhook through the same pipeline real events use, confirming delivery and signature verification end to end. Returns 404 when the agent has no webhook.

list_voices.title: List voices
list_voices.description: List the named text-to-speech voice presets (female-1, male-1 and so on) usable as voice_id on an agent, a call or the account default. Any valid Cartesia voice UUID works as well.

get_account_voice.title: Get the account voice
get_account_voice.description: Read the account-wide default voice. Resolution order is the per-call voice, then the agent's, then this, then the system default.

set_account_voice.title: Set the account voice
set_account_voice.description: Set the default voice for every agent on the account that does not set its own. Per-agent and per-call voices still win.

voice_id.description: TTS voice preset name (e.g. 'female-1', 'male-1') or Cartesia voice UUID

reset_account_voice.title: Reset the account voice
reset_account_voice.description: Remove the account-wide voice override so agents without their own voice fall back to the system default.

get_account_balance.title: Get balance and rates
get_account_balance.description: Read the prepaid balance with the rate card for calls, numbers and inbound SMS, and what the balance can still cover. Check it before a paid operation.

output.description: The balance, currency, rates and coverage.

get_balance.title: Get balance
get_balance.description: Read just the available USD balance that pays for calls, numbers and inbound SMS. get_account_balance adds the rate card.

get_usage.title: Get usage
get_usage.description: Summarize a billing period's call volume, message counts, active numbers, balance and estimated cost.

period.description: current_month (default), last_month, all_time, or a month as YYYY-MM.

list_transactions.title: List transactions
list_transactions.description: Page through the ledger, newest first -- call charges, number provisioning, inbound SMS charges, top-ups and refunds.

txn_type.description: Only this kind: call_charge, number_provision, inbound_sms_charge, topup or refund.

get_expenditure.title: Get expenditure breakdown
get_expenditure.description: Break a period's spend down by category -- voice calls, number provisioning, top-ups and refunds -- with counts and averages.

period.description: current_month (default), last_month, all_time, or a month as YYYY-MM.

list_call_charges.title: List call charges
list_call_charges.description: List what each call cost, with its duration, direction, numbers and time.

list_number_charges.title: List number charges
list_number_charges.description: List what each phone number cost to provision, with the number, country and current status.

verify_call_billing.title: Verify a call's charge
verify_call_billing.description: Check that a finished call was billed correctly: the expected charge from its duration, the actual ledger entry, and whether the deduction was applied.

output.description: The call, expected and actual charge, and a deducted flag.

get_spending_summary.title: Get monthly spending
get_spending_summary.description: Total debits month by month, for spotting spending trends.

months.description: How many months back to include.

create_topup_quote.title: Create a top-up quote
create_topup_quote.description: Quote a USDC top-up of the balance over x402. The response is an x402 PaymentRequired object -- amount, network, asset and receiving wallet -- to pay with an x402 client and then settle with settle_topup.

amount.description: USD to add, between 5.00 and 1000.00; 1 USDC is about 1 USD.

output.description: The x402 payment requirements and the settle url.

list_topups.title: List top-ups
list_topups.description: List x402 top-up quotes and settlements, newest first, optionally only pending, settled or expired ones.

status.description: Only pending, settled or expired top-ups.

get_topup.title: Get a top-up
get_topup.description: Read one x402 top-up quote's status -- pending, settled or expired -- and its settlement details.

settle_topup.title: Settle a top-up
settle_topup.description: Settle a paid x402 top-up and credit the balance. Pass the base64 PaymentPayload your x402 client produced; the payment is verified and settled on-chain. Replaying the same payment returns the recorded settlement without charging twice.

payment_signature.description: Base64-encoded x402 PaymentPayload for this quote.

output.description: The transaction hash, payer address and new balance.

list_api_keys.title: List API keys
list_api_keys.description: List the account's API keys by prefix, creation time and revocation time. Secrets are never returned.

create_api_key.title: Create an API key
create_api_key.description: Mint an additional API key for the account, e.g. for a separate environment. The plaintext key appears only in this response -- store it.

output.description: The new key, in plaintext this one time.

revoke_api_key.title: Revoke an API key
revoke_api_key.description: Permanently revoke an API key. The key this connection is authenticating with cannot revoke itself.

submit_feedback.title: Submit feedback
submit_feedback.description: Report a bug, request a feature, flag a difficulty or leave general feedback for the AgentLine team, optionally tied to an agent and with a follow-up email.

message.description: Detailed description of the feedback, issue, or request. For bugs, include what you expected vs. what actually happened.

subject.description: Short summary title for the feedback (optional)

contact_email.description: Email address for follow-up about this feedback (optional)

list_feedback.title: List feedback
list_feedback.description: List feedback submitted from this account, optionally by category or by status (open, acknowledged, in_progress, resolved, closed), to track a reported bug.

category.description: Only bug, feature_request, difficulty or feedback.

status.description: Only open, acknowledged, in_progress, resolved or closed.
